mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP above 2% YoY signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 5% signals a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to potential inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where unemployment rate is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above 1% MoM signals a strong supply environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where industrial production growth exceeds 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a low federal funds rate and a high GDP growth rate signals a strong monetary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a high housing starts rate and a low unemployment rate signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where housing starts rate is high and unemployment rate is low.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in payroll employment below 100,000 signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where payroll employment growth is below 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a high federal funds rate and a low CPI growth rate signals a strong monetary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
